scope: Independent Pantheon+SH0ES-only flat-LambdaCDM calibration reconstruction, before using this alternative in a CMB+BAO joint fit.
data: Pinned ReleasedCalibration selection and full released covariance; use its explicit symmetric-average convention and keep all calibrator/noncalibrator cross blocks.
physics: Flat FLRW with matter and a cosmological constant over the released SN redshifts; radiation omitted in this bounded late-time reconstruction. D_L=(1+zHEL)c/H0 integral_0^zHD dz/E(z). Calibrators use released Cepheid distances.

priors.measure: Independent uniform Omega_m and H0; integrate one improper flat absolute-magnitude M. No additional H0, anchor or Cepheid prior.

method: At fixed Omega_m, h=5log10(H0/70) enters the projected SN residual linearly only for noncalibrators. Integrate its Gaussian quadratic exactly with the dH0/dh Jacobian and finite H0 bounds. Integrate Omega_m by deterministic quadrature. Recover H0 CDF and moments from the resulting mixture of truncated lognormal components.
numerical_checks: Gauss-Legendre redshift integrals at64 and128 nodes, with independent adaptive quadrature at fixed predeclared Omega_m and redshifts.
Omega_m Gauss-Legendre quadrature at256 and512 nodes, plus independent adaptive scalar integrals.
Direct released likelihood evaluations versus projected h-quadratic at Omega_m0.1,0.3,0.5,0.8 and H050,65,75,90.
Direct H0 quadrature against analytic conditional normalization and first two moments; all constants and Jacobian retained.
Expanded H0 prior[30,110] and Omega_m[0.001,0.999] as numerical prior-bound sensitivity, reported separately.
comparison: Brout et al.2202.04077v2 Table3 reports H0=73.6+-1.1 and Omega_m=0.334+-0.018 for flat-LambdaCDM Pantheon+SH0ES. Compare declared numerical inputs and assumptions; do not force agreement or assume identical historical code/priors.
resource_limit: One CPU, no CMB spectra, no Monte Carlo sampling. Do not edit any active cosmological target.
